name: Typography Vortex
description: Nested rotating glyph rings with a local dissolution lens and a finite suction pulse.
usage: Use the component with a short text phrase; keep the adjacent Pause/Replay controls from the example.
accessibility: Readable DOM content survives stillness, reduced motion, hidden tabs and offscreen suspension. Repeated SVG/canvas glyphs are decorative. Pointer effects retain native scrolling and cursor.
landing: Optional playground backdrop; skip the main reading flow.
notes: SVG glyph rings retain the vortex and pointer lens; dust is bounded and suction recenters the rings rather than reproducing the upstream bitmap renderer.
observation: Concentric bitmap rings, pointer dissolution and click suction in ThreeUI TypographyVortexRenderer.

usage: Use the component with a short text phrase; keep the adjacent Pause/Replay controls from the example.
accessibility: Readable DOM content survives stillness, reduced motion, hidden tabs and offscreen suspension. Repeated SVG/canvas glyphs are decorative. Pointer effects retain native scrolling and cursor.
landing: Use as a restrained brand band below the hero; the main headline can stay static.

observation: React Bits TextLoop measures an SVG path and repeats text over it.

name: Particle Text
description: Particles sampled from real glyph pixels gather into a readable phrase and repel the local pointer.
usage: Use the component with a short text phrase; keep the adjacent Pause/Replay controls from the example.
accessibility: Readable DOM content survives stillness, reduced motion, hidden tabs and offscreen suspension. Repeated SVG/canvas glyphs are decorative. Pointer effects retain native scrolling and cursor.

notes: Canvas sampling is capped by stage size and sample step. DOM text stays in the accessibility tree; fallback is visible during stillness.
observation: React Bits ParticleText samples canvas alpha, gathers points and adds local pointer repulsion.

name: Warp Text
description: Rendered text deforms through a slowly changing noise displacement.
usage: Use the component with a short text phrase; keep the adjacent Pause/Replay controls from the example.
accessibility: Readable DOM content survives stillness, reduced motion, hidden tabs and offscreen suspension. Repeated SVG/canvas glyphs are decorative. Pointer effects retain native scrolling and cursor.

observation: React Bits SplitText uses GSAP split units and scroll-triggered entrance.

name: Circular Text
description: Circular text with hover pause or speed response.
usage: Use the component with a short text phrase; keep the adjacent Pause/Replay controls from the example.

observation: React Bits CircularText positions glyphs in a circle and animates rotation with hover speed changes.

name: Text Pressure
description: Local pointer proximity expands width and weight through Bricolage variable-font axes.
usage: Use the component with a short text phrase; keep the adjacent Pause/Replay controls from the example.

observation: React Bits TextPressure interpolates per-letter wght, wdth and optional ital axes from pointer distance.

name: Variable Proximity

usage: Use the component with a short text phrase; keep the adjacent Pause/Replay controls from the example.

observation: React Bits VariableProximity parses variable axes and interpolates them by per-letter distance.

name: Word Stream
description: Phrases build word by word, drift left and run out before the final phrase holds.
usage: Use the component with a short text phrase; keep the adjacent Pause/Replay controls from the example.
accessibility: Readable DOM content survives stillness, reduced motion, hidden tabs and offscreen suspension. Repeated SVG/canvas glyphs are decorative. Pointer effects retain native scrolling and cursor.

notes: Native finite clock with wrapping phrases. The original is a Remotion frame sequence and assumes one unwrapped video line. WordRelay alone lacks this horizontal stream mechanism.
observation: Remocn WordStream schedules pipe-separated phrases, per-word reveals, entry drift and accelerated exit.

name: Caret Swap

observation: Remocn CaretSwap expands right-to-left, collapses, then accelerates typing into replacement text.
